_comment: AI model artifacts the visitor's browser downloads at run time (they are not in the site bundle). Which models exist is read from the shipped code by `gen:sbom-versions:check` (WebLLMService.ts, public/data/embeddings-meta.json, and the URLs inside the bundled @mlc-ai/web-llm); licenses and revisions below were read from the model repositories on `fetchedAt` because no shipped file carries them. The site pins no revision for any of them, so each follows its repository's default branch and this record is a dated snapshot, not a guarantee.

models.licenseSource: base model Qwen/Qwen3-8B (revision b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218) declares apache-2.0; the mlc-ai conversion repository declares no license of its own

models.role: compiled model library for the chat model
models.licenseSource: the mlc-ai/binary-mlc-llm-libs repository reports no license

models.role: text embeddings for search and the assistant (quantized ONNX, q8)
models.licenseSource: the Xenova repository declares mit; base model BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 (revision a5beb1e3e68b9ab74eb54cfd186867f64f240e1a) declares mit
